chose: In the decay record, a ticket with no take of the whole ticket and points answered by takes of their own is at the lowest of those takes' SOLO levels; a whole take's level still wins where there is one, and a ticket with neither is a silence (or, unheard, no check) as before. A ticket whose every point is answered only by takes home couldn't make out is no check at all, as C431 has it.
gray: The record keeps one level per ticket while the points are judged apart; which one stands for the ticket's concepts is a judgement about what "shown" means.
